description: Seeking sources only, this notice is NOT a solicitation. The Central Arkansas Veterans Healthcare System (CAVHCS) is seeking a contractor to support the following requirement: Deployable Critical Equipment Bunkhouse Vehicle Repair Services. Repairs are required due to physical damage that was sustained on the unit. Please refer to attachment “S02 FINAL Sources Sought Notice 36C25626Q0750 Deployable Critical Equipment Bunkhouse Vehicle Repair Services” that is contained within this notice.
